dict.string: Dawri uses the camera to scan the door code at your health centre. Nothing the camera sees is saved or sent. You can type the code instead.
Dawri connects to a clinic server on your local network only if you choose Clinic server in Settings.
Dawri checks that you have reached your health centre when you tap I'm here. Your location is used only for that check.
Dawri uses the microphone so you can speak to the receptionist instead of typing. Speech stays on this phone. Audio is never sent or stored.
Dawri turns your speech into text on this phone, and you check the text before it is sent. Speech stays on this phone. Audio is never sent or stored.
